21.description: The committee recommends amending the multi-year budget policy to remove the mandatory indicative tax rate process and allow more flexibility, while also updating contingency wording.

chips.text: Councillor Donauer clarified Council can still set a property tax target.

23.description: The committee recommends prioritizing speakers from council-appointed boards and committees at city committee meetings, moving their communications earlier on agendas.

chips.text: Affects advisory committees, board of revision, civic naming, municipal planning

9.description: Various city updates were provided to Council through five reports.

22.description: Council received a report on the implications of adding 250-meter separation distances between facilities for people experiencing homelessness and childcare facilities, and requested more information from other jurisdictions.

chips.text: Children in licensed daycare facilities, including 90 at YWCA Wall Street
Public delegations cited observed drug activity, loitering

24.description: Saskatoon will spend $128,000 from reserves to boost safety patrols and overnight coverage at the Avenue C drop-in and public washroom, aiming to reduce social disorder.

chips.text: Fire department's SHA contract for medical calls is two decades outdated.
Outdoor washroom sees 400-500 daily users; Avenue C drop-in, 150-211.
The timeline for a new SHA funding agreement for fire department medical calls is uncertain.
A property manager praised the Pacific Avenue shelter's coordinated safety plan as highly effective.
City Manager Jorgenson committed to reporting site-specific costs for future shelters.

25.description: Council reviewed and received information on various referral lists, administrative priorities, and inquiries from the Governance and Priorities Committee and City Council.

19.description: Council formally concluded its private meeting, noting that discussions included a conference bid and future appointments to various boards and committees.

chips.text: Recommended appointments to boards, commissions, and committees will be reported on June 24, 2026.
